# ntcore-ts

> TypeScript and React clients for WPILib NetworkTables 4.1 (Node.js and browser).

- Docs: https://ntcore.chrislawson.dev
- Getting started: https://ntcore.chrislawson.dev/guide/getting-started
- React: https://ntcore.chrislawson.dev/guide/react
- API: https://ntcore.chrislawson.dev/api/
- GitHub: https://github.com/cjlawson02/ntcore-ts

## Packages

- `@ntcore-ts/client` — core NetworkTables client
- `@ntcore-ts/react` — `NtcoreProvider` and hooks
